verdict.rationale: Community posts confirm that Rollbar has a GitHub source code integration, with credentials stored encrypted, and the Resolve agent produces pull requests, which implies repo access. Deploy tracking and source maps give version and original file/line context. Item Owner is a manually designated Rollbar user, not repo-derived code ownership. missing for 10: documented suspect-commit attribution on issues, CODEOWNERS-based code-owner assignment, stack-frame links to the exact line on the default branch, and first-party docs for the source control integration itself.
